rites.name: Halarnen
rites.text: Halarnen is the concept of the first sounding in Mienys, the undated hum by which the earliest roots of the world gathered into form. It is not a being but the pattern that all early condensation follows, so it is remembered as a tone rather than a figure.

rites.name: Osiaseth
rites.text: Osiaseth is the concept of resonance that holds the first roots of Mienys together, a sounding felt as a low hum beneath all matter. In the Age of Sundering it is said to have answered the break of old bonds by pulling fractured earth back toward a single note.

rites.name: Ilyema
rites.text: Ilyema is the concept of a resonance that rang through Mienys as the first roots condensed out of the undifferentiated hum, shaping the earliest matter into lasting form. It was named and remembered during the Age of Strangers, when visiting traders used it as a measure of what could be anchored and exchanged.

rites.name: Druldenar
rites.text: Druldenar is a concept of Mienys, a resonance that the first roots of the world tuned into existence during the Singing, before any calendar could hold it. In the Age of Strangers it was the chord outsiders learned to anchor their trade-ships to, so that goods could cross the seams between shores.

rites.name: Eluarora
rites.text: Eluarora is a concept of the Mienys Arcane Realm, a presence that governs the threshold between seasons of thought and form. Within the Courts of the second Era, it is said to hold open the doors between worlds by sheer patience rather than force.

rites.name: Drathurn
rites.text: Drathurn is the concept of a sleeping arcane current woven into Mienys during the Seeding, when makers planted the Weave and its quiet powers were set to rest. In the Age of Sundering it stirred only as a faint tide beneath the landfall that broke old bonds between peoples.

rites.name: Vhorkar
rites.text: Vhorkar is the concept of a binding tide that ran through Mienys during the Fall, when worlds split apart and the Pact was sworn over the broken shards. It is remembered as the force that held the first sovereign's groves together as the kingdoms grew around them.

rites.name: Vorouktokun
rites.text: Vorouktokun is a concept of Mienys, a binding-principle that holds the walls of the Walled Age together and lends its name to the orders that tend them. In the Age of the first sovereign it was said to steady the groves and the growing kingdoms against the slow erosion of their borders.

rites.name: Silaerinwen
rites.text: Silaerinwen is a bloodline of wandering song-weavers in the Mienys, descended from a fey mother who bargained her laughter for the power to bend moonlit fog. Their gifts flow through breath and memory, letting them fold a glade into a second dusk or lull a storm with a single held note.

rites.name: Nuinuarae
rites.text: Nuinuarae is a guild-craft of silver-tongued thieves in the drowned city of Mienys, whose practitioners unlock sealed minds and vaults with the same murmured rhythm. Their most feared art lets a single whispered refrain slip the locks of an entire regime's secrets at once.

rites.name: Ilyirelora
rites.text: Ilyirelora is a Mienys concept of silence-keeping, a discipline in which practitioners unravel enchantments by drawing their residual force into sealed vessels of pale glass. Its adepts can call forth a Hollowed Warden, a void-stitched sentinel that devours sorcerous current and leaves nothing behind but stillness.

rites.name: Oriinora
rites.text: Oriinora is a dormant sigil-lattice woven through the bedrock of Mienys, a concept of resonant geometry that stores and releases stray arcane pressure. Scholars describe it as a patient engine that remembers every spell cast above it, and its surges have been recorded to reshape whole valleys in a single breath.

rites.name: Thastora
rites.text: Thastora is a concept within the Mienys omniverse, a shaped idea that appears where the Three Futures diverge and the Library files each outcome on its own shelf. It was born in the Age of Sundering, when landfall split old bonds between peoples and left the cosmos to choose new paths.
